pages.text: The $(thing)Mineral Prospector$() scans a large range, a massive 45x45x45 centered on the clicked block, but only for non-metal ores.
pages.title: Mineral Prospector

pages.text: A mold for the tool head can be $(l:getting_started/pottery)knapped$() from clay, as seen above, which can be used to $(l:getting_started/finding_ores#casting)cast$() low tier metals.
A $(thing)Mineral Prospector Head$() can also be $(l:mechanics/anvils#working)smithed$() out of a $(thing)double ingot$() of any tool metal. Craft the head with a stick to make a Mineral Prospector.
